name: Zechariah
overview: Zechariah was a male Levite from the Gershonite family, specifically a descendant of Asaph. His lineage is noted in 2 Chronicles 29:13, identifying him within the tribe of Levi and connecting him to the Gershonites, descendants of Gershon, son of Levi. This heritage places him within the priestly and musical traditions of ancient Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Zechariah means 'YHWH remembers,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew proper name. This meaning highlights God's faithfulness and remembrance, though the name was not given directly by God according to the record in 2 Chronicles 29:13.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Zechariah as a descendant of Asaph, situating him within a notable Levitical family known for temple music and worship. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zechariah's significance lies in his identity as a Levite connected to Asaph, who was renowned for temple music and worship leadership. As a Gershonite, Zechariah would have served in specific Levitical duties related to the tabernacle or temple. His mention in 2 Chronicles 29:13 underscores his role in the organized Levitical service during the reforms of King Hezekiah, reflecting the restoration of proper worship centered on God.
